project_structure:
Flask web application with template-based rendering:
- Flask backend (app.py): Handles routing, API endpoints, and server-side logic
- Jinja2 templates (templates/*.html): HTML structure with embedded Python logic
- Static assets (static/css/main.css): CSS design system with CSS custom properties
- Database layer (database.py, config.py): Data persistence and configuration
- Bot integration (bot/*): Telegram bot functionality

Key architectural patterns:
- Server-side rendering with Flask/Jinja2
- RESTful API endpoints for AJAX operations (delete, favorite, calibrate)
- CSS-based responsive design with media queries
- JavaScript event handlers for client-side interactions
- Modular component structure (sidebar, topbar, cards, modals)

relevant_files.rationale: Main UI template with extensive mobile-specific code already present (lines 585-612: mobile media queries, 1021-1042: mobile sidebar toggle, 1109-1130: mobile viewport detection). Contains all major interaction points: sidebar navigation, search, filter panel, note cards, pagination, image modals.

CSS design system with existing responsive breakpoints (lines 734-778: @media queries for 1024px and 768px). Defines all interactive component styles: sidebar (lines 125-339), topbar (lines 355-537), buttons (lines 599-680), forms (lines 683-720). Uses CSS custom properties for theming.

Flask backend with API routes that need mobile optimization (lines 63-715: all routes). Critical endpoints: /notes (line 196), /toggle_favorite (line 434), /delete_note (line 424), /api/calibrate (line 606). No mobile-specific logic currently.
Admin panel with minimal responsive design. Contains form inputs and buttons that need touch optimization (lines 203-233: password form). Mobile media queries missing.
Login page with single mobile media query (line 270: @media max-width 480px). Password toggle button (line 344) needs touch optimization.
WebDAV configuration page with one responsive breakpoint (line 220: @media max-width 768px). Form-heavy page requiring input field sizing optimization.
Note editing interface with mobile media query (line 201: @media max-width 600px). Textarea and buttons need touch-friendly sizing.
Task queue management with inline onclick handlers (lines 367-371). Table layout may need horizontal scrolling on mobile.
Configuration management with no mobile-specific logic. May need viewport-based configuration loading in future.
Data layer with no direct UI integration. Backend optimization may affect mobile API response times.

patterns.template_rendering:
Server-side Jinja2 rendering with inline JavaScript:
- Pattern: Flask routes return render_template() with context data
- Example: app.py:241-252 - notes() route passes notes_list, sources, pagination to template
- Mobile consideration: No separate mobile templates; responsive design via CSS/JS only
patterns.event_handling:
Mixed inline onclick and addEventListener patterns:
- Inline onclick: templates/notes.html:676 onclick="toggleSidebar()"
- Event delegation: templates/notes.html:1114 mainContent.addEventListener('click')
- Mobile issue: Inline onclick lacks touch feedback, needs passive event listeners for scroll performance
patterns.api_interaction:
Fetch API for AJAX operations with JSON responses:
- Pattern: fetch(`/api/endpoint/${id}`, {method: 'POST'})
- Examples: toggleFavorite (line 1158), deleteNote (line 1175), calibrateNote (line 1214)
- Mobile consideration: No request throttling or debouncing for slow connections
patterns.responsive_breakpoints:
CSS media queries with three breakpoints:
- Desktop default (no media query)
- Tablet: @media (max-width: 1024px) - main.css:739
- Mobile: @media (max-width: 768px) - main.css:763
- Small mobile: @media (max-width: 480px) - notes.html:608
- Pattern: Mobile-last approach (desktop first, then override for smaller screens)
patterns.state_management:
Client-side state in DOM classes and localStorage:
- Sidebar collapsed state: sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed')
- Theme preference: localStorage.getItem('theme') - notes.html:1096
- Mobile sidebar: sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open') - notes.html:1035
- Issue: No state persistence for mobile-specific preferences
patterns.component_architecture:
BEM-like naming with component-based CSS:
- Sidebar: .sidebar, .sidebar-header, .sidebar-nav, .nav-item
- Cards: .note-card, .note-media, .note-content, .note-footer
- Pattern: Modular components with shared design tokens (CSS custom properties)
patterns.form_handling:
Traditional form submission with POST requests:
- Example: notes.html:774 <form method="GET" action="/notes">
- Search: Hybrid approach - form submit OR Enter key listener (line 1083)
- Mobile issue: No autocomplete attributes, no input mode hints for numeric keyboards

dependencies.backend:
Flask 2.x framework with extensions:
- Flask core: routing, request/response handling, session management
- Jinja2: template rendering engine (version bundled with Flask)
- MarkupSafe: HTML escaping (app.py:4 - from markupsafe import Markup, escape)
- Database: SQLite with custom database.py module
- No mobile-specific backend dependencies
dependencies.frontend:
Vanilla JavaScript with no frameworks:
- No jQuery, React, Vue, or other frameworks
- Pure DOM manipulation: document.getElementById, classList API
- Fetch API for AJAX (requires modern browser)
- CSS Grid and Flexbox for layout
- CSS Custom Properties (requires IE11+ or modern browsers)
- No mobile gesture libraries (Hammer.js, etc.)
dependencies.media_handling:
Server-side media streaming:
- Local files: send_from_directory() - app.py:396
- WebDAV proxy: requests.get() with streaming - app.py:369
- Image modals: client-side modal with onclick events - notes.html:994
- No lazy loading, no responsive images (srcset)
dependencies.authentication:
Flask session-based auth:
- Session storage: app.secret_key - app.py:12
- Login check: 'username' in session - app.py:65, 198, etc.
- No JWT, no OAuth, no mobile-specific auth flow
dependencies.storage:
Hybrid local/WebDAV storage:
- StorageManager class - app.py:21-43
- WebDAV client for remote storage - bot/storage/webdav_client.py
- Configuration: config.py with JSON file persistence
- No mobile-specific caching strategy

integration_points.ui_components:
Key touch interaction points requiring mobile optimization:

1. Sidebar Navigation (templates/notes.html:618-680, static/css/main.css:125-339)
   - Current: Fixed left sidebar, width transitions on desktop, translateX on mobile
   - Mobile behavior: Off-canvas overlay (line 750: transform: translateX(-100%))
   - Toggle: toggleMobileSidebar() at line 1021
   - Issue: No swipe gesture support, Z-index conflict (line 752 notes mobile-open needs z-index 1001)
   - Integration: Requires gesture detection library OR native touch events

2. Search Bar (templates/notes.html:690-698)
   - Current: Collapsible search with toggleSearch() at line 1052
   - Mobile: Hidden by default (@media 768px), toggle button shows/hides
   - Issue: No focus trap, search input too small (height: 32px line 432)
   - Integration: Needs larger touch target (min 44x44px), autocomplete attributes

3. Note Cards (templates/notes.html:824-903, static/css/main.css:202-606)
   - Current: CSS Grid layout with responsive columns (line 197: minmax(320px, 1fr))
   - Mobile: Single column at 768px (notes.html:587)
   - Touch points: Favorite button (line 828), action buttons (line 880-897), expand text (line 871)
   - Issue: Button sizes below 44px recommendation, no touch ripple feedback
   - Integration: Swipe gestures for delete/favorite actions

4. Image Modals (templates/notes.html:994-997, lines 1188-1204)
   - Current: Click to open, ESC/click-outside to close
   - Issue: No pinch-to-zoom, no swipe-to-dismiss
   - Integration: Touch events for zoom (touch-action CSS), swipe gestures

5. Pagination (templates/notes.html:906-932)
   - Current: Traditional link-based pagination
   - Issue: Small touch targets (min-width: 40px), no infinite scroll option
   - Integration: Larger buttons OR infinite scroll with Intersection Observer API

6. Filter Panel (templates/notes.html:762-820)
   - Current: Accordion-style with CSS transitions (max-height animation)
   - Mobile: Form inputs stack to single column (line 595)
   - Issue: Date pickers may not be touch-optimized, dropdowns need larger hitboxes
   - Integration: Native mobile date pickers (input type="date"), custom dropdowns

7. Action Buttons (templates/notes.html:880-898)
   - Current: Small buttons (padding: 6px 12px, font-size: 12px) at line 404-405
   - Issue: Below 44x44px minimum touch target
   - Integration: Increase button sizing for mobile, add touch active states
integration_points.api_endpoints:
Backend routes needing mobile-aware optimization:

1. /notes (app.py:196-252)
   - Returns: Server-rendered HTML with paginated notes
   - Mobile need: Pagination parameter validation, smaller page size for mobile
   - Integration point: Detect user-agent OR add ?mobile=1 query param

2. /toggle_favorite/<note_id> (app.py:434-443)
   - Returns: JSON {success: bool, error?: string}
   - Mobile optimization: Add request debouncing (300ms), optimistic UI updates
   - Integration: Client-side retry logic for flaky mobile connections

3. /delete_note/<note_id> (app.py:424-432)
   - Returns: JSON {success: bool, reload: bool}
   - Mobile issue: No undo mechanism, confirmation dialog not touch-friendly
   - Integration: Toast notifications instead of alert(), swipe-to-delete gesture

4. /api/calibrate/<note_id> (app.py:606-714)
   - Long-running operation (up to 30s timeout line 641)
   - Mobile issue: No progress indicator, connection may timeout
   - Integration: WebSocket OR SSE for progress updates, background task queue

5. /media/<storage_location> (app.py:343-401)
   - Returns: Image/video streaming
   - Mobile issue: No responsive image sizes, full-resolution loads
   - Integration: Image resizing service, srcset attributes, lazy loading
integration_points.javascript_events:
Event handlers requiring mobile touch optimization:

1. Sidebar Toggle (notes.html:1000-1042)
   - Desktop: toggleSidebar() - width transition
   - Mobile: toggleMobileSidebar() - translateX transform
   - Integration need: Touch swipe from edge to open/close, velocity detection

2. Click Outside to Close (notes.html:1114-1120)
   - Pattern: mainContent.addEventListener('click') closes mobile sidebar
   - Issue: May conflict with touch scrolling
   - Integration: Use touchend instead of click, check if dragging occurred

3. Image Modal (notes.html:838, 1188-1204)
   - Opens: onclick="openImageModal(this.src)"
   - Closes: ESC key listener (line 1202) OR click modal background
   - Integration need: Pinch-to-zoom with Hammer.js OR native touch-action

4. Search Input (notes.html:1083-1091)
   - Trigger: Enter key on input field
   - Issue: Virtual keyboard may hide content, no dismiss on scroll
   - Integration: Blur input on scroll, use input type="search" for native X button

5. Text Expansion (notes.html:871, 1143-1154)
   - Toggle: onclick="toggleText(noteId)" shows full note text
   - Issue: No smooth scroll to expanded content on mobile
   - Integration: scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth'}) after expansion

6. Window Resize (notes.html:1133-1140)
   - Listens: window.addEventListener('resize')
   - Purpose: Reset sidebar state when switching desktop/mobile
   - Issue: Fires too frequently on mobile (address bar show/hide)
   - Integration: Debounce resize handler (200ms), use matchMedia instead
integration_points.css_breakpoints:
Responsive design integration points:

1. Main CSS Breakpoints (static/css/main.css:734-778)
   - 1024px: Tablet/small desktop transition
     - Sidebar becomes off-canvas (line 745-753)
     - Main content loses left margin (line 756)
     - Grid columns reduce (line 759-760)
   - 768px: Mobile portrait
     - Topbar padding reduces (line 765)
     - Search bar hides (line 768)
     - Page container padding reduces (line 772)
     - Grid becomes single column (line 776)
   - Integration: Add 480px breakpoint for small phones, 1440px for large desktops

2. Template-Specific Breakpoints (templates/notes.html:585-612)
   - 768px: Note cards, stats bar, filter grid, action buttons
   - 480px: Stats bar single column
   - Integration: Consolidate breakpoints with main.css, use CSS custom property for breakpoint values

3. Component Responsive Patterns:
   - Sidebar: Fixed → Off-canvas (main.css:739-753)
   - Topbar: Full search → Hidden + toggle button (main.css:763, notes.html:481-482)
   - Cards: Multi-column grid → Single column (notes.html:586-588)
   - Forms: Multi-column → Stacked (notes.html:594-596)
   - Buttons: Horizontal → Full-width stacked (notes.html:598-606)
   - Integration point: Viewport meta tag (notes.html:5), CSS custom properties for breakpoint consistency
integration_points.state_persistence:
Client-side state management integration:

1. Theme Preference (notes.html:1044-1050, 1095-1099)
   - Storage: localStorage.getItem('theme')
   - Toggle: Sets data-theme attribute on <html>
   - Integration: Sync with backend user preferences, detect system dark mode preference

2. Sidebar Collapsed State
   - Current: Only DOM class, no persistence
   - Issue: Sidebar state resets on page reload
   - Integration: localStorage for desktop, sessionStorage for mobile

3. Search/Filter State
   - Current: URL query parameters (?page=1&source=xxx&search=yyy)
   - Issue: No history management, no state restoration
   - Integration: History API for SPA-like navigation, preserve scroll position

4. Form Input State
   - Current: Browser autocomplete only
   - Issue: Search query not preserved in collapsed search box
   - Integration: sessionStorage for form values, autocomplete attributes
integration_points.performance_bottlenecks:
Mobile-critical optimization points:

1. Image Loading (templates/notes.html:833-856)
   - Current: All images load immediately, no lazy loading
   - Issue: Slow initial page load on mobile connections
   - Integration: Intersection Observer API for lazy load, loading="lazy" attribute

2. JavaScript Execution (notes.html:999-1239)
   - Current: All event listeners registered on DOMContentLoaded
   - Issue: Blocking main thread, slow Time to Interactive
   - Integration: Event delegation, passive event listeners, debouncing/throttling

3. CSS Animations (static/css/main.css:82-86)
   - Current: Backdrop-filter blur (line 358-359) is GPU-intensive
   - Issue: Janky scrolling on low-end mobile devices
   - Integration: Disable blur on mobile, use will-change sparingly

4. API Request Timing (app.py calibrate endpoint)
   - Current: Synchronous 30s timeout operations
   - Issue: Mobile connection drops, no retry
   - Integration: Background jobs, retry logic with exponential backoff
integration_points.mobile_specific_needs:
Features requiring mobile-only implementation:

1. Touch Gestures
   - Swipe sidebar from left edge to open
   - Swipe left/right on note cards to delete/favorite
   - Pull-to-refresh on note list
   - Pinch-to-zoom on images
   - Integration: Hammer.js library OR native touch events with gesture detection

2. Virtual Keyboard Handling
   - Viewport resize when keyboard appears
   - Fixed positioning issues with keyboard open
   - Input field auto-scroll into view
   - Integration: Visual viewport API, input focus detection, scroll behavior

3. Offline Support
   - Cache recent notes for offline viewing
   - Queue actions (favorite/delete) when offline
   - Sync when connection restored
   - Integration: Service Worker, IndexedDB, Background Sync API

4. Native Features
   - Share API for sharing notes
   - Vibration API for touch feedback
   - Install as PWA
   - Integration: Web Share API, navigator.vibrate(), manifest.json + service worker

5. Network Awareness
   - Detect connection type (2G/3G/4G/WiFi)
   - Reduce image quality on slow connections
   - Defer non-critical requests
   - Integration: Network Information API, adaptive loading strategies

constraints.technical:
1. No Frontend Framework: Vanilla JS only - no React/Vue/Angular means manual DOM manipulation and event handling. Adding mobile libraries (Hammer.js) must not conflict with existing code.

2. Server-Side Rendering: Flask/Jinja2 templates - all HTML generated server-side. Client-side routing not possible without major refactor. Mobile optimizations must work with full page reloads.

3. CSS Custom Properties: Extensive use of CSS variables (lines 6-86 in main.css). Mobile styles must respect existing design token system. Cannot use CSS frameworks (Bootstrap/Tailwind) without conflicts.

4. Inline Event Handlers: Mixed onclick attributes and addEventListener. Mobile touch events must work with both patterns. Cannot easily add event delegation without refactoring all inline handlers.

5. No Build Process: No webpack/vite/babel. Cannot use JSX, TypeScript, or modern ES modules. Mobile JS must be ES5-compatible or use feature detection.

6. SQLite Database: Single-file DB with no replication. Mobile API optimizations cannot add complex queries that lock database.

7. Single Threaded Flask: Development server is single-threaded. Mobile long-polling or SSE will block other requests. Need production WSGI server (gunicorn) for concurrent mobile connections.
constraints.design:
1. Existing Breakpoints: Three breakpoints already defined (1024px, 768px, 480px). Mobile styles must fit within this system. Cannot change breakpoint values without updating multiple files.

2. Color Scheme: NetEase Cloud Music inspired (red primary #EC4141). Dark mode already implemented. Mobile components must respect existing color tokens and theme switching.

3. Component Sizing: Sidebar width 200px/64px, topbar 56px, cards 320px min. Mobile adaptations must maintain visual consistency. Cannot drastically change component proportions.

4. Grid Layout: CSS Grid with auto-fit minmax pattern. Mobile single-column is already implemented. Cannot use Flexbox without conflicting with existing grid definitions.

5. Animation System: Transition timings defined (150ms/250ms/350ms). Mobile animations must use existing timing tokens. Cannot add jarring animations that conflict with design language.

6. Font System: System fonts only (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, etc.). Mobile text sizing must scale from existing font-size tokens (12px-24px range). Cannot use custom web fonts.

7. Icon System: Emoji-based icons (📝🏠⭐etc.). Mobile touch targets must accommodate emoji size. Cannot replace with icon fonts without redesigning entire UI.
constraints.browser_support:
1. Modern Browsers Only: Fetch API, CSS Grid, CSS Custom Properties required. Must support Chrome 90+, Safari 14+, Firefox 88+. IE11 not supported.

2. Mobile Browsers: Primary targets are Chrome Mobile, Safari iOS, Samsung Internet. Must test on iOS 14+ and Android 10+. No support for outdated mobile browsers.

3. Feature Detection: No polyfills for missing APIs. Mobile features (Web Share, Vibration) must have fallbacks. Use 'if (navigator.share)' pattern.

4. CSS Prefixes: Backdrop-filter needs -webkit- prefix (line 359). Mobile CSS must include vendor prefixes for transform, transition, appearance.

5. Touch Events: Must support both touch and pointer events. Cannot assume mouse-only or touch-only. Use pointer events where possible for unified handling.
constraints.performance:
1. No Code Splitting: All JS loads on page load. Mobile optimizations cannot add large libraries without affecting initial load time. Keep additional JS under 50KB.

2. Image Sizes: Full-resolution images load from /media endpoint. Mobile cannot request different sizes without backend changes. Must use CSS to scale images.

3. No CDN: Static files served from same domain. Mobile users far from server will have high latency. Cannot add CDN without infrastructure changes.

4. Synchronous Operations: Calibrate endpoint blocks for 30s. Mobile optimizations cannot make it asynchronous without backend refactor. Must improve UX with loading states only.

5. Database Locking: SQLite locks entire database on write. Mobile API calls cannot add concurrent writes. Must queue operations client-side.

6. No Caching Strategy: No service worker or HTTP caching headers. Mobile offline support requires implementing entire caching layer from scratch.
constraints.compatibility:
1. Existing Users: Current desktop users must not experience regressions. Mobile changes must be additive, not replacing desktop functionality. Use CSS media queries, not separate mobile site.

2. URL Structure: Routes are hardcoded (/notes, /admin, /login). Mobile cannot change URL patterns without breaking bookmarks. Must preserve query parameter structure.

3. Session Management: Flask sessions with cookies. Mobile cannot use JWT or token auth without backend changes. Must work with existing session-based auth.

4. Data Format: JSON responses from API endpoints have fixed structure. Mobile cannot request different data shapes. Must work with existing {success: bool, error: string} pattern.

5. Template Structure: Jinja2 inheritance with base templates. Mobile cannot add separate template hierarchy. Must use same templates with responsive CSS.

6. JavaScript Globals: Functions defined in template script tags (toggleSidebar, deleteNote, etc.). Mobile JS cannot use modules or bundling. Must add to global scope or refactor existing code.
constraints.deployment:
1. Docker Container: App runs in Docker with specific paths (/app/). Mobile features must work in containerized environment. Cannot rely on file system paths outside container.

2. Environment Variables: Configuration via env vars (TOKEN, HASH, ID, etc.). Mobile cannot add new config without updating deployment scripts. Must use existing config.json pattern.

3. Port Configuration: Flask runs on configurable port (default 5000). Mobile cannot assume specific ports. Must use relative URLs only.

4. Volume Mounts: Data persists in /data volume. Mobile caching must use this path. Cannot write to other locations in container.

5. No HTTPS: Development mode uses HTTP. Mobile features requiring HTTPS (Web Share, geolocation) will fail. Must detect protocol and disable features or require reverse proxy.

clarification_needs.question: 移动端适配的响应式断点策略
clarification_needs.context: 当前存在3个断点(1024px, 768px, 480px),但分散在main.css和notes.html中。移动端适配需要统一断点管理并可能新增超小屏幕(320px-375px)和大屏手机(414px-428px)的专属断点。
options: 保持现有3个断点,仅优化现有断点下的样式(最小改动,快速完成)
统一到CSS变量管理,新增2个移动断点(320px小屏, 375px标准手机, 768px平板)
采用容器查询(Container Queries)替代媒体查询,实现组件级响应式(现代方案,需浏览器支持)
使用JavaScript动态检测视口并添加类名,CSS基于类名而非媒体查询(灵活但增加JS依赖)

clarification_needs.question: 触摸手势支持的实现方式
clarification_needs.context: 移动端需要支持侧边栏滑动、图片缩放、笔记卡片滑动删除等手势。当前无任何手势库,需决定实现方式。
options: 不引入手势库,仅优化现有点击交互(按钮加大、增加触摸反馈,无滑动手势)
引入Hammer.js手势库(30KB gzipped),支持滑动、捏合、长按等手势
使用原生Touch Events手动实现必要手势(侧边栏滑动、图片缩放),代码量较大但无依赖
使用Pointer Events统一处理触摸和鼠标,仅实现基础滑动手势(现代API,兼容性好)

clarification_needs.question: 移动端图片加载优化策略
clarification_needs.context: 当前所有图片立即加载,移动端网络较慢会导致页面卡顿。需决定图片优化方案。图片由/media/<storage_location>端点提供,支持本地和WebDAV。
options: 仅添加loading="lazy"属性,利用浏览器原生懒加载(最简单,但无法自定义占位符)
使用Intersection Observer API实现懒加载+模糊占位符(用户体验好,需额外JS)
后端添加图片缩放服务,移动端请求小尺寸图片(最彻底,需后端开发)
添加渐进式JPEG支持+响应式图片(srcset),前端无需改动(需构建流程)

clarification_needs.question: 移动端离线支持的优先级
clarification_needs.context: 笔记应用有离线查看需求,但实现Service Worker和IndexedDB需要大量工作。需确定是否纳入本次适配范围。
options: 不实现离线支持,仅优化网络慢时的加载体验(骨架屏、加载动画)
实现基础Service Worker缓存静态资源(CSS/JS),页面内容仍需网络
完整离线方案:缓存最近浏览的笔记+离线操作队列(工作量大,3-5天开发)
使用localStorage缓存笔记列表,下次访问优先展示缓存(简易离线,但容量限制5MB)

clarification_needs.question: 虚拟键盘遮挡问题的处理方案
clarification_needs.context: 移动端输入时虚拟键盘会遮挡输入框和底部内容。当前无任何键盘适配逻辑,搜索框、筛选表单、编辑页面都会受影响。
options: 使用window.visualViewport API检测键盘高度,动态调整容器padding(现代方案,iOS 13+支持)
监听resize事件估算键盘高度,使用scrollIntoView滚动输入框到可见区域(兼容性好但不准确)
使用position: fixed布局的输入框自动避开键盘(简单但可能导致其他布局问题)
不做特殊处理,依赖浏览器默认行为(可能在某些设备上输入框被遮挡)

clarification_needs.question: 移动端API请求优化方式
clarification_needs.context: 当前API无移动端优化:无请求去抖、无超时重试、无离线队列。校准操作可能耗时30秒,移动端易超时。
options: 仅前端优化:添加加载状态、防抖节流、乐观更新UI(不改后端,快速实现)
添加请求重试机制(指数退避)+超时提示(前端JS,增强鲁棒性)
后端改造:长耗时操作改为异步任务+轮询结果(需后端开发,用户体验最佳)
前端添加Service Worker拦截请求,实现离线队列和后台同步(复杂,需PWA基础设施)

_metadata.task_description:
GOAL: 完全适配移动端
SCOPE: 移动端响应式布局、触摸交互优化、移动端用户体验
CONTEXT: 现有项目需要全面移动端适配
